title: ✦ sheet: closing it no longer stops the mic

set.outcome:
**What landed:** closing the ✦ sheet now leaves the mic running, as asked.

- [x] auto-start mic on open — unchanged
- [x] closing the sheet (✕, drag down, phone back) no longer stops the mic — its own `hide()` was calling `stop_mic()` on every close; that was the whole bug, not the mic-hijack rule
- [x] still stops when it should — the page-hidden/`pagehide` rule, and the one real edge case left (the window widened past 52em), are both untouched
- [x] dictation keeps posting into the same conversation while closed — reopening the sheet, or the desktop drawer's AI tab, shows it

Fix + detail: [`ext/drawer/rail.js`](/framework/ext/drawer/rail/), doc'd at [`doc/sheet.md`](/framework/ext/drawer/doc/sheet/) and [`ux/Dictate/readme.md`](/framework/ux/Dictate/).

Not proved live — every execution tool (`node`, the `site`/Servex MCP) was refused this session; verified by a full manual code trace instead.
